situation.en: 74 armed incidents were reported in Yemen in the past seven days, 37% more than the week before. Most were armed clashs (66%), followed by aerial or missile strikes (20%). 26 of them were carried by two or more outlets. The most reported locations over the past month were Sanaa, Mokha and Marib. UCDP lists 3 active armed conflicts here, the oldest dating from 1948. The most widely covered story this week: “Days of Deadly Houthi Attacks Show Saudi Arabia’s Vulnerabilities” (The New York Times, 2 outlets).
situation.nb: 74 væpnede hendelser ble meldt i Jemen de siste sju dagene, 37 prosent flere enn uken før. Flest gjaldt væpnet sammenstøt (66 prosent), deretter luft- eller missilangrep (20 prosent). 26 av dem ble omtalt av to eller flere medier. De mest omtalte stedene den siste måneden var Sanaa, Mokha og Marib. UCDP fører 3 aktive væpnede konflikter her, den eldste fra 1948. Mest omtalte sak denne uken: «Days of Deadly Houthi Attacks Show Saudi Arabia’s Vulnerabilities» (The New York Times, 2 medier).

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
